search_text: published ZDI-19-032 ZDI-CAN-7120 Schneider Electric IIoT Monitor UpgradeMgmt upload Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2019-01-16 CVE-2018-7836 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2018-7836 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Schneider Electric'] ['IIot Monitor'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Schneider Electric IIoT Monitor. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability but authentication can be easily bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the upload method of the UpgradeMgmt servlet, which listens on port 8080 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Schneider Electric has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
